events.title: TOP2BTTM at SOS7MILE
events.description:
TOP2BTTM! NEW SPOT! SAME GAY SHIT! 

We are thrilled to announce our newest residency at Detroit’s hottest new club - SOS 7 MILE has opened it’s doors, and we’re taking the first Friday ;) 

Equipped with a brand new state of the art sound system, cheap drinks, a HUGE space, plus the hottest queer party in town?! Oh it’s going to be SEXY!! 

JOIN US FRIDAY for our first party in the new space, we gathered our favorite gay boys to christen the decks.
 
With T2B Boss WE1SMAN at the helm, Garrison XR + TYLR_ join Residents M00N-Pi + Sina, to keep you dancing all night long!! 

And yes we’re going late ;)

events.title: Care 4 Us Fest
events.description: Join us for an exciting evening full of amazing performers from Detroit and a special guest appearance from the original political drama Scandal as we prepare to cast our votes early for the MI midterm. We'll have food trucks, healthcare screenings, local merch, resource vendors and small businesses, and even our own care salon with stylists and barbers hooking us up FOR FREE. We're bringing community care back to politics! All ages welcome.

events.title: Sunday Revival with Eddie Logix & Peter Croce
events.description:
Rocksteady Disco returns to MotorCity Wine for SUNDAY REVIVAL! This event continues a monthly residency at MotorCity Wine with the Rocksteady Disco friendship circle.

For October, Eddie Logix and Peter Croce get the band back together for a night of extended b2b bliss.

+++ 

The 2 will be playing 5+ hours of unexpected and danceable deep house, jazz, funk, balearic, new wave, disco, and cosmic.
